title: 七座城市，下一餐有方向

delivery.platform: GitHub README native video + downloadable master + GIF fallback

sources: Authentic screenshots of this repository's built pages. sources/capture-report.json and sources/manifest.json record source hashes, viewports and UI actions. No substituted app UI, invented map tiles or venue data.

beats.headline: 七座城市，下一餐有方向。
beats.purpose: Establish the expanded atlas and its seven real cities; China comes first.

beats.headline: 同一张好地图，看见城市好味。
beats.purpose: Show Shanghai's redesigned real map and directory, with its dining and nightlife collections described.

beats.headline: 从北京，到江南。
beats.purpose: Show four actual Chinese city maps and correctly distinguish Beijing's published 2027 edition from 2026 editions.

beats.headline: 香港，也在地图上。
beats.purpose: Introduce Hong Kong within China, with 147 directory records and 146 verified map points.

beats.headline: 换座城市，继续好好吃饭。
beats.purpose: Move to Korea only after China; show the existing Seoul map and Korean navigation.

beats.headline: 从想吃，到出发。
beats.purpose: Show actual mobile search and restaurant detail for Ren He Guan; no simulated clicks or invented UI.

beats.headline: 把下一站，放进地图。
beats.purpose: Resolve with seven cities, ten theme maps and a readable project address.

tracks.picture: Saved real product screenshots; composited card motion is editorial camera motion, not an app screen recording
tracks.graphics: Paper/wine typography matching the new product; country and city labels outside the UI
tracks.music: Original deterministic synthesis from make_audio.py, no external samples or dialogue

transitions: Motivated scene cuts with 4-frame paper dips; single-layer slide/scale entrances. No scaled-image crossfades.

checks: Country order China then Korea; Hong Kong within China
Authentic current UI and fully loaded basemap
No claim that all directory records have coordinates
Preview assets and checksums from final master
